narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Divide by sixty, then by twenty four. That is about nineteen hundred years ago.
<bookmark mark='steps'/>Sixty seconds make a minute, sixty minutes make an hour, and twenty four hours make a day.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>He skipped the step from minutes to hours, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows ÷ 60 ÷ 24, about 1900 years ago; the chain seconds ÷ 60 → minutes ÷ 60 → hours ÷ 24 → days appears with the middle step glowing; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, multiply your days by the seconds in a day.
<bookmark mark='near'/>The answer should come close to one arab, which is ten to the power nine.
removed_beats.on_screen: the check line multiply back, days × 86400 appears; the check line it should come close to one arab appears

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu divides by sixty and then by twenty four, and says about nineteen hundred years ago. He turned minutes straight into days and skipped the hours, so the bubble is struck.
